1.consolidated_definition: Vereda o camino, natural o artificial usado para hacer caminatas y ejercitarse al exterior. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Las instalaciones recreativas incluyen casa club, gimnasio equipado, minigolf, dos canchas de tenis, una cancha de baloncesto, dos piscinas, gazebo con B.B.Q., área de juegos para niños y walking trail para caminar o joguear (El Nuevo Día, 02-10-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Trail or path, natural or artificial used for walking and exercising outdoors. Raw Anglicism, infrequently used. Recreational facilities include a clubhouse, equipped gym, mini golf course, two tennis courts, one basketball court, two pools, gazebo with BBQ area, children's play area, and walking trail for walking or playing.
